Where a plan reads its sources

plan_reads.Rd

Lists the windows a plan's read stages read and the source pixels and tiles behind each, without reading any pixels. A read stage reads its grid in windows: the chunks the planner cut, grown to whole read tasks where collect() would grow them for a plan that only reads. Each window maps onto its source file by the route that reads it:

Usage

plan_reads(x, tiles = FALSE, distributed = garry_daemons_set())

Arguments

x

A LazyRaster, a LazyDataset (its bands are stacked first, as in collect()) or a Plan from plan_lazy().

tiles

List one row per source tile, with its bytes, instead of one row per window?

distributed

As in collect(): whether the plan is read by the daemon pools, which reads a remote mosaic by fetching its items.

Value

A data frame with one row per window: stage, route, chunk, path, band (comma-separated for a band stack), overview, the window x_off, y_off, x_size, y_size in the stage's grid, halo included, the source window src_x_off, src_y_off, src_x_size, src_y_size in the file's pixels (rows from the north), and the inclusive tile range tile_x0, tile_y0, tile_x1, tile_y1 with the tile size tile_x_size, tile_y_size (tile rows count from the file's first row, the south edge of a south-up file). With tiles = TRUE, one row per window, band and tile in place of the range: file, overview, band, tile_x, tile_y, offset, length.

Details

  • "read": a source read on its own pixels, the window itself.

  • "direct": a warp served by a plain or decimating read of the file (an aligned target), the window scaled into the file.

  • "warp": a warp through GDAL's warper, the box of the window's footprint on the source, padded for the resampling kernel as the warper pads its source windows.

  • "window_warp", "mosaic", "zarr", "coarsen": reads of several files, a mosaic (a GTI index, or a local VRT of files placed across its extent), a Zarr array or a coarsened warp. Their windows are listed, their source windows and tiles are NA: each of them reads its files in its own pieces.

Tiles are the file's blocks: a COG's tiles, a striped file's strips. A local VRT reads through to its files and is described by the tiles its SourceProperties record, which holds for a VRT whose bands each take one file on the VRT's own pixels, such as a classic VRT of a daily series. A footprint is a box, so a rotated or curved warp lists tiles in its corners that it does not read.

A read onto a coarse grid reads an overview of its file where the file has them: a warp the level gdalwarp picked for it, a decimating read the one GDAL's RasterIO takes (the coarsest no coarser than the read). Its source window and tiles are then that overview's, numbered in overview (0 the first, NA full resolution); finding it opens the file's overviews.

With tiles = TRUE each window becomes one row per source tile, with the tile's byte offset and length in its file, from the file's TIFF metadata (0 for a tile a sparse file leaves empty). This opens each file, and a remote file costs its header fetch, if it is not open already. A VRT's window takes the file under its centre (GDAL's LocationInfo), whose tiles are listed only where it has the VRT's size and one band.

See also

plan_view() for the stages themselves.

Examples

f <- system.file("extdata", "storml_elev.tif", package = "gdalraster")
r <- lazy_source(f)
plan_reads(r)
#>   stage route chunk
#> 1     1  read     1
#>                                                                 path band
#> 1 /home/runner/work/_temp/Library/gdalraster/extdata/storml_elev.tif    1
#>   overview x_off y_off x_size y_size src_x_off src_y_off src_x_size src_y_size
#> 1       NA     0     0    143    107         0         0        143        107
#>   tile_x0 tile_y0 tile_x1 tile_y1 tile_x_size tile_y_size
#> 1       0       0       0       3         143          28
plan_reads(r, tiles = TRUE)
#>   stage route chunk
#> 1     1  read     1
#> 2     1  read     1
#> 3     1  read     1
#> 4     1  read     1
#>                                                                 path
#> 1 /home/runner/work/_temp/Library/gdalraster/extdata/storml_elev.tif
#> 2 /home/runner/work/_temp/Library/gdalraster/extdata/storml_elev.tif
#> 3 /home/runner/work/_temp/Library/gdalraster/extdata/storml_elev.tif
#> 4 /home/runner/work/_temp/Library/gdalraster/extdata/storml_elev.tif
#>                                                                 file overview
#> 1 /home/runner/work/_temp/Library/gdalraster/extdata/storml_elev.tif       NA
#> 2 /home/runner/work/_temp/Library/gdalraster/extdata/storml_elev.tif       NA
#> 3 /home/runner/work/_temp/Library/gdalraster/extdata/storml_elev.tif       NA
#> 4 /home/runner/work/_temp/Library/gdalraster/extdata/storml_elev.tif       NA
#>   band tile_x tile_y offset length
#> 1    1      0      0    526   5012
#> 2    1      0      1   5538   4996
#> 3    1      0      2  10534   5183
#> 4    1      0      3  15717   4326
